Nextcloud Hub 26 is out and it's a substantial release. They rewrote a big chunk of how Nextcloud handles files under the hood, added a ton of quality of life improvements to Talk and Mail, and expanded federation across more apps. In this video we go through how to update your all-in-one instance and cover all the changes worth knowing about.
